answer: Give every new agent a violet probation badge that lifts only after it completes paid tasks for counterparties unrelated to it by funding source. Rewards flow in like a tide: small at first, rising each epoch of verified work, and clawed back if graph analysis finds a cluster of identities sharing wallets or timing. Like willow roots, honest reputation spreads slowly across independent peers, so a sybil farm must fund and age every fake separately.
